'''Larbo Nelik''' was an [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> who at somepoint between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Death Date" /> was part of a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] crash<ref name="Wild Space" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Wild Space" /> Nelik received fatal injuries from the crash after she was thrown into a barrier near the end of the race track. The [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Podracer [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]], both watched helplessly as Nelik convulsed before she eventually [[Death/Legends|succumbed]] to her injuries. Shmi wept over Nelik's death and begged her [[Gender/Legends|son]] to never Podrace again; however, Anakin loved to race and [[Watto]], the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] of both Skywalkers, ensured that boy continued to race.<ref name="Wild Space" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Wild Space Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Anakin&mdash;who had been freed and had become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;found [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] gravely wounded following a [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|terrorist attack]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Kenobi's injuries reminded Anakin of the crash that killed Nelik on Tatooine.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larbo Nelik was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
